'''''Cyperus retrorsus''''', commonly called '''pine barren flatsedge''',<ref name=usda/> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the sedge family ([[Cyperaceae]]). It is found primarily in the [[Southeastern United States]], with a range extending north to [[Martha's Vineyard]], [[Massachusetts]]<ref name=GoBotany/><ref name=BONAP/> and south to [[Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]].<ref name=fna/> Its natural habitat corresponds to dry sandy soils, open woodlands and thickets.<ref name=fna/>

''Cyperus retrorsus'' is a tufted perennial, growing to around {{cvt|50|cm}} tall. Its fruits mature in the summer.<ref name=fna/> It is similar to the closely related [[Cyperus echinatus|''C. echinatus'']], from which ''C. retrorsus'' can be distinguished by its cylindrical inflorescence and shorter stature.<ref name=GoBotany/>
